items.title: Show HN: Inca – a free, open-source 3D app that works like Maya 2020
items.desc: description: Inca is a free, opensource 3D modeling, animation and rendering application for Windows, Mac and Linux that works like Maya 2020. title: Inca image: https://incacad.com/img/og.jpg Inca Inca: free 3D modeling, animation and rendering The Maya 2020 workflow in an opensource desktop app for Windows, Mac and Linux. [ ](img/hero.webp) [↓ Explore Inca](features) Free · MIT license [Download](download) [Source code](https://github.com/v3ai/inca) 3D modeling Build anything, and change it later Polygon modeling on ngon meshes with extrude, bevel, bridge, multicut, booleans, quad draw and sculpting brushes. NURBS primitives, and CV, EP, pencil and arc curves for revolve, loft and extrude. Every step keeps its construction history, so you can go back and change a bevel's segments after the fact. [](img/four.webp) Animation & rigging Bring characters to life Set keys, scrub the Time Slider and shape motion in the Graph Editor and Dope Sheet. Build skeletons with IK, bind skin and paint weights, then drive them with constraints, deformers, blend shapes and set driven keys. [](img/graph.webp) Look development Shade in the Hypershade Create Standard Surface, Lambert, Blinn and Phong materials, connect file, checker, ramp, noise and grid textures in the node graph, and drag the result onto your models. [](img/hypershade.webp) Rendering Render without leaving the app A physically based path tracer for final frames and a fast hardware renderer for previews. Compare images in the Render View, or batch a whole sequence to your project's images folder. [](img/render.webp) Customization Script it with MEL or JavaScript Every menu item and tool echoes the command it ran. Paste it into the Script Editor, wrap it in a loop, and save it to the shelf. [See all features](https://github.com/v3ai/inca/blob/master/FEATURES.md) [](img/script.webp) What's included One app for the whole pipeline Interface Menu sets, shelves, hotbox, marking menus, Channel Box, Attribute Editor, Outliner and workspaces. UVs Planar, cylindrical, spherical and automatic projection, plus a UV Editor with unfold and layout. Lighting Directional, point, spot, area and ambient lights, and a sky dome with HDRI or procedural sky. Dynamics Particle emitters, fields, active and passive rigid bodies, and fire and smoke presets. Files Projects, autosave and recent files. Import OBJ, FBX, glTF/GLB and STL; export OBJ, glTF/GLB and STL. Editors Graph Editor, Dope Sheet, UV Editor, Hypergraph, Connection Editor and Script Editor. For Maya users Your hotkeys already work Inca follows Maya 2020's layout, default hotkeys and naming, down to pCube1 and polyCube1. There's nothing new to learn before you start. Q W E R Select, move, rotate, scale Alt \+ drag Tumble, track, dolly Space Hotbox, or tap for four views F A Frame selected, frame all 1 2 3 Smooth mesh preview 4 5 6 7 Wireframe, shaded, textured, lights F8 – F12 Object and component modes S Set key Download Get Inca No installer, no account. Download it and start working. Windows 64bit. The portable exe runs without installing anything. If SmartScreen stops it, click More info, then Run anyway. [Portable .exe ](https://github.com/v3ai/inca/releases/latest) [.zip ](https://github.com/v3ai/inca/releases/latest) Linux 64bit AppImage for most distributions. Make it executable with chmod +x, then run it. [AppImage ](https://github.com/v3ai/inca/releases/latest) macOS Drag Inca into Applications. The first time, macOS can't verify it: open System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway. [Apple Silicon ](https://github.com/v3ai/inca/releases/latest) [Intel ](https://github.com/v3ai/inca/releases/latest) Release notes and older versions are on the [releases page](https://github.com/v3ai/inca/releases). FAQ Questions Is Inca really free? Yes. It's open source under the MIT license, with no subscription or account, and you can use it for commercial work. Can it open Maya scenes? Not .ma or .mb files. Bring models across as OBJ, FBX or glTF. Inca saves its own scenes as .inca files. Is it made by Autodesk? No. Inca is an independent project that recreates the Maya 2020 workflow. It isn't affiliated with Autodesk. Is there a Mac version? Yes, as a .dmg for Apple Silicon (M1 and newer) and Intel Macs. Inca isn't registered with Apple, so the first time you open it, go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway. You only do this once. How do I report a bug or ask for a feature? Open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/v3ai/inca/issues). It helps to say how Maya behaves in the same situation. Pull requests are welcome too. Start modeling today [Download Inca](download) [View on GitHub](https://github.com/v3ai/inca)
items.author: v3ai
items.descZh: Inca 是一款面向 Windows、Mac 和 Linux 的开源免费 3D 建模、动画与渲染软件，其核心定位是独立复刻 Maya 2020 的完整工作流，为用户提供轻量且免费的替代方案。软件集成了多边形与 NURBS 建模、骨骼绑定与动画、节点式材质着色，并提供物理路径追踪渲染器用于最终渲染，以及快速硬件渲染器用于实时预览。其核心亮点在于完全遵循 Maya 2020 的界面布局、默认快捷键和命名规则（如 pCube1），使现有 Maya 用户能够零学习成本地直接迁移。此外，Inca 支持 MEL 和 JavaScript 脚本编写，所有操作均会 echoing 对应命令，便于开发者构建高度自定义的自动化工具。该软件适用于需要免费开源工具进行教学、独立游戏开发或个人艺术创作的 3D 师生、学生及独立开发者。
items.quote: Inca 是一款适用于 Windows、Mac 和 Linux 的免费开源 3D 建模、动画和渲染应用程序，其工作方式类似于 Maya 2020。

How the mile pace calculator finds your pace Your average pace per mile is your total time divided by the number of miles you covered. For instance, if you run five miles in 40 minutes, each mile takes eight minutes on average, so your result is 8:00 per mile. A smaller time per mile means you’re covering the same distance faster. Pace = total time ÷ distance Finish time = pace × distance Distance = total time ÷ pace [](https://milepacecalculator.com/wpcontent/plugins/milepacecalculators/assets/media/maininfographic.webp?v=25d8831bb5aa) A visual reference for the worked answer explained in this section. [Open fullsize infographic ↗](https://milepacecalculator.com/wpcontent/plugins/milepacecalculators/assets/media/maininfographic.webp?v=25d8831bb5aa) For a calculation by hand, changing the total time to seconds makes the division easier: four miles in 35 minutes is 2,100 seconds divided by four, giving 525 seconds per mile. That’s 8 minutes 45 seconds, written as 8:45/mi. The units follow your distance: time divided by miles gives minutes per mile, while time divided by kilometers gives minutes per kilometer. A result in a “per mile” field is a duration, such as 8:45, and labels like min/mi, mile pace and minutes per mile describe that same measure. How to use pace, time and distance modes You need two values to calculate the third: distance and time for pace, distance and pace for finish time, or time and pace for distance. The tabs let you choose the answer you’re looking for, so you can use the same calculator for a completed run or a planned workout. The racedistance menu includes a 2 Miles preset, and custom entries accept distances such as 1.8 or 3.2 miles without rounding them to a whole mile. For a onemile run, total time and mile pace are the same: one mile in 8:00 gives an 8:00 mile pace. Protocol](https://agentclientprotocol.com) v2 agent. Your editor talks to it over stdio; it thinks with any OpenAIcompatible Chat Completions API, [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai)first, and works in your workspace through tools. Inspired by [acpbridge](https://github.com/BlakeHung/acpbridge), which serves as a behavioral reference for the tool loop, limits and error handling. acplause follows the pinned ACP v2 specification for its wire protocol. acplause is experimental. Calendar versions identify releases; they do not promise compatibility. Breaking changes are highlighted in release notes. ACP v2 only, validated against the pinned schema (testdata/schema/v2). Streaming text and reasoning, tool calls, usage and cost reporting. Live bash terminal output with bounded snapshots for session replay. Asks permission before changing files or running commands. Prompt queue, cancellation that aborts the HTTP stream and kills everything a command started, session list/resume/close/delete. Sessions survive restarts and can move between editor windows. Model and reasoning effort selection from OpenRouter's model list. PNG/JPEG prompt attachments and MCP tool images for models known to accept images. Sessionowned MCP tools over stdio and Streamable HTTP. Structured user questions on clients advertising ACP form elicitation. Native ACP execution plans with persistent progress snapshots. Persession Plan/Build modes with enforced tool restrictions. A discoverable /compact command to summarize older model context on demand. Install Homebrew brew install anesthetised/tap/acplause The formula builds the tagged source on your machine, installing Go as a build dependency. On macOS, local compilation lets us distribute acplause without a paid Apple Developer ID certificate or an install hook that removes quarantine from downloaded binaries. The tradeoff is a slower first install, including compilation of the SQLite dependency. Release archives For a readytorun binary without installing Go, download the archive for your OS (macOS or Linux) and architecture (arm64 or amd64) from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/anesthetised/acplause/releases). items.descZh: acplause是一个实验性的Agent Client Protocol (ACP) v2代理，旨在作为编辑器与AI模型之间的桥梁，灵感来源于acpbridge，专注于工具循环、限制和错误处理。它通过标准输入输出（stdio）与编辑器通信，利用任何兼容OpenAI的Chat Completions API（优先使用OpenRouter）进行推理，并通过工具在用户工作区中执行操作。支持流式文本和推理、工具调用、使用情况和成本报告，以及实时bash终端输出，具有有限的快照用于会话回放。该代理在修改文件或运行命令前会主动请求权限，提供提示队列和取消功能（可中止HTTP流并终止所有子进程），支持会话的创建、恢复、关闭和删除，且会话在重启后仍可保留并可在不同编辑器窗口间迁移。它允许从OpenRouter模型列表中选择模型和推理力度，支持PNG/JPEG附件和MCP工具图像，并提供结构化用户问题、原生ACP执行计划、计划/构建模式以及/compact命令，以优化上下文管理。适用于需要深度集成编辑器的AI开发助手场景，特别是那些需要精细工具控制、会话管理和模型选择的复杂工作流。

items.author: FSALINAS26

items.descZh: 这篇文章描述了作者在Turbo Fieldfare项目基础上进行的优化工作，该项目原本能在Apple Silicon Mac上以极低内存占用运行Gemma 4 26B模型。作者通过改进成功将推理速度提升至每秒100多个token，大幅提高了在内存受限设备上运行大型语言模型的效率。核心功能是让配备Apple Silicon的Mac能够流畅运行260亿参数的Gemma 4模型，无需大量RAM。亮点在于将推理速度提升到100+ tokens/s，使得在普通消费级Mac上实时体验大模型成为可能。这一方案特别适合希望在本地Mac上体验前沿AI模型、同时又受限于内存容量的开发者和爱好者。
